name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-11-24, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
